small_guidance: Swap the loop nest so IC is the innermost reduction (current code already has it inside KD/KH/KW, but expose it as a vectorized GEMM-K with BLOCK_IC≥8 by tiling ic in chunks and using tl.dot of [BLOCK_SP,BLOCK_IC]×[BLOCK_IC,BLOCK_OC]); cut registers/thread (currently 123, occupancy 16.7%) by hoisting kd/kh/kw index math outside the ic loop and using smaller BLOCK_SP=32 with BLOCK_OC=32 num_warps=4 to lift theoretical occupancy. Also fold the BN scale and per-(N,C) mean subtraction into the conv epilogue once the conv is faster, eliminating the separate fused_bn_submean pass.
large_guidance: Rewrite the conv-transpose as a scatter-add GEMM: for each (N, input-spatial tile, IC tile) compute outer product input[N,IC]×W[IC,OC,KD,KH,KW] using tl.dot, then atomically/serially add into the OD×OH×OW output grid with stride/pad index math — this exposes a real (M=OC, N=spatial, K=IC) GEMM via tl.dot rather than the current scalar FMA loop (compute-bound at 95% SoL with no tensor-core use). Use channels_last layout so IC is contiguous for the GEMM-K dimension, and fuse the BN affine + per-(N,C) spatial-mean subtraction into a two-pass epilogue (first pass accumulates partial sums during scatter, second pass normalizes) so the 0.8 ms BN pass collapses into the conv launch.
